<!-- pr-reviewer: ff3ba1497180b62f195f9a50eae2d7de8e8ca5b1 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I read the complete diff and issue #3275. I checked the rules in the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.

The guide now gives Stepdown as 5. This value agrees with `Carried.stepdown` in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:63`.
The helper accepts the block format from `xtask/src/catalog_links.rs`. It preserves section text when a block is incomplete.
The decision file records the choice and the alternatives.

Local results, with upstream/main `79d47c28229aaad15a564c82d0214debae0473ef`:

- Trial merge: clean. The first parent is the full PR head above.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green; 0 steps, 0 failures, 0 stalls. The final plan lists three changed files.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: green; 6 steps, 0 failures, 0 stalls; 16.9 minutes.
- Release build for the light gate: passed.
- `motion light: lib`: 7 tests passed.
- `motion light: adaptive_troch_island`: 1 test passed.
- `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck`: 1 test passed.
- `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`: 1 test passed.
- `app light: pocket_pass_start`: 1 test passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed. The worktree is clean.

Extra suites run:

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_icons.py -k section_lead -v`: 3 tests passed.
- The same command with `-k vcarve_stepdown`: 1 test passed.
- The same command with `-k operation_sections`: 1 test passed.
- No fixture or importer changed. The extra kernel and importer suites do not apply.

Mutations:

- I used the upstream helper in memory. Both malformed-block tests failed as expected. Both passed with the PR helper restored.
- I supplied the upstream guide in memory. The default-value test failed as expected. It passed with the PR guide restored.
- These checks did not change a source file.

Requested before merge: none.

Scope and notes:

- This PR changes no G-code, geometry, collision check, stock simulation, runtime operation, or UI code. The safety review tier and UI screenshots do not apply.
- No recorded program or golden changed. No full heavy lane applies. The catalog suites do not apply.
- No Rust source changed, so I did not run clippy.
- I did not run the unrelated static-icon test or Zola rendering. The body reports missing site icons. Those icon files are also absent from upstream/main.
- The existing unused `truck-polymesh` workspace dependency produces a build warning. It does not fail the gate.
- I used no GitHub runner. I will keep the review worktree and branch for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merging as SAME (no head movement since the counted review). The review that stands: `<!-- pr-reviewer: ff3ba1497180b62f195f9a50eae2d7de8e8ca5b1 -->` by mkinney, clean at head `ff3ba1497180b62f195f9a50eae2d7de8e8ca5b1`. Merge commit pinned with `--match-head-commit`.
